releaseNotes: Notes Pro 0.12.0 introduces persistent multi-page handwritten and typed notes
Pen, marker and eraser tools are available with marker opacity from 1/10 to 10/10
BOOX stylus backside eraser handling is enabled where Android WebView exposes the eraser signal
Each note page stores text and vector-style stroke data in the portable LuMa Notes v2 model
Notes can be linked to a LuMa project and handed directly to LuMa AI as context
Existing luma.notes.v1 text notes are migrated into the new v2 note model
Library Pro, Reader Pro, Work Pro foundation and LuMa Sync foundation remain available
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
